text: As our Palestinian brethren mark the 78th solemn anniversary of Nakba, we remember the enduring suffering and displacement of the Palestinians from their homeland since 1948. On this solemn occasion, Pakistan reaffirms its unwavering solidarity with our Palestinian brothers and
translated_text: 在我们的巴勒斯坦兄弟隆重纪念大灾难 78 周年之际，我们铭记自 1948 年以来巴勒斯坦人离开家园所遭受的持久苦难和流离失所。在这个庄严的时刻，巴基斯坦重申坚定不移地声援我们的巴勒斯坦兄弟和巴勒斯坦人民。

text: At least 80 deaths have been reported in Congo's new Ebola disease outbreak in the eastern Ituri province, authorities said, as health workers raced Saturday to intensify screening and contact tracing to contain the disease.
translated_text: 当局表示，刚果东部伊图里省爆发的新埃博拉疫情已造成至少 80 人死亡，卫生工作者周六加紧加强筛查和接触者追踪，以遏制该疾病。

text: Wes Streeting, who resigned as U.K. health secretary this week, announced Saturday he will run to replace Keir Starmer as Labour leader and prime minister, after the party suffered disastrous local election results.
translated_text: 本周辞去英国卫生部长职务的韦斯·斯特里廷周六宣布，在工党遭遇灾难性的地方选举结果后，他将接替凯尔·斯塔默担任工党领袖和首相。

text: The Supreme Court on Friday rejected a bid by Virginia Democrats to revive its new voter-approved congressional map that was drawn to advantage the party for the upcoming midterm elections.
translated_text: 最高法院周五驳回了弗吉尼亚州民主党提出的恢复其经选民批准的新国会地图的提议，该地图旨在为该党在即将到来的中期选举中带来优势。

text: Straus Family Creamery is voluntarily recalling a variety of organic ice cream flavors and sizes sold in 17 states because of concerns there may be metal fragments in the frozen treats, the Food and Drug Administration said Friday.
translated_text: 美国食品和药物管理局周五表示，由于担心冷冻食品中可能含有金属碎片，Straus Family Creamery 主动召回在 17 个州销售的各种口味和尺寸的有机冰淇淋。

text: Russian President Vladimir Putin will meet with Chinese leader Xi Jinping on a two-day trip to Beijing next week, the Kremlin said Saturday.
translated_text: 克里姆林宫周六表示，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将于下周在北京进行为期两天的访问时会见中国领导人习近平。

text: Trump says U.S. kills Islamic State leader in Nigeria
translated_text: 特朗普称美国在尼日利亚击毙伊斯兰国领导人
